cards.title: Mutter — Intro
cards.description: A green-lit animated Rammstein emblem from the Mutter-era website.
cards.instructions: Watch the intro. SKIP and ENTER HERE belong to the original website navigation; that destination is not included. Use Restart to replay.
cards.status: Partial — intro and audio work; original website destination is absent
cards.notes: Original SWF unchanged. Archive filename: '2001 - Mutter.swf'; that year is an archival label, not a verified release date. Animation, audio, mute, restart and fullscreen were checked in Chromium. Both in-card navigation buttons target the missing original index.html. See PROVENANCE.md and VERIFICATION.md.

cards.title: Ich will
cards.description: An interactive scanning display: move across the video stills to draw lines and reveal the Ich will artwork.
cards.instructions: Let the intro finish, including its black interval. Move the pointer across the stage, then hold still to see the display react. On a touchscreen, drag a finger across the image.
cards.status: Verified playback — pointer visualizer and audio
cards.notes: Unmodified movie extracted from the preserved Windows projector. Year supported by the embedded 'RELEASE 10_09_2001' text. Pointer movement/stillness, audio and player controls were checked in Chromium. Historical RealMedia, order and send-to-a-friend links are not restored. Physical touch-device interaction has not been verified.

cards.title: Mutter — E-card
cards.description: A German Mutter e-card with specimen and DNA imagery, album information and historical tour dates.
cards.instructions: Open MENU at the bottom left, then choose MUTTER or TOUR to explore the preserved panels. The original German interface is retained.
cards.status: Verified playback — intro, menu and tour panel
cards.notes: Unmodified movie extracted from the inner projector in '2002 - Mutter.exe'. The archive year is not a verified release date; the card refers to the 2001 album/tour. Menu and TOUR navigation, audio and player controls were checked. RealMedia/RTSP video and e-card delivery are not restored. Extraction details and corrected text-export encoding are documented in PROVENANCE.md.

cards.title: Lichtspielhaus
cards.description: An industrial console promoting the Lichtspielhaus DVD, with an embedded trailer and original competition information.
cards.instructions: Let the intro play, then click INFO, WIN or TRAILER on the console. ORDER opens an external historical shop link.
cards.status: Verified playback — console and embedded trailer
cards.notes: Unmodified movie extracted from the preserved projector. Archive label 2003 is not treated as a verified year. Console interactions, embedded trailer/audio and player controls were checked. Some additional flash/*.swf modules mentioned in the code are absent, but the exercised trailer does not need them. Original competition and order services are not recreated.

cards.title: Reise, Reise
cards.description: Explore Reise, Reise through its flight-recorder artwork, band photographs, album information and sound snippets.
cards.instructions: Click the small deutsch or english label on the left to begin. Then use START, SOUND SNIPPETS and INFO across the top. Fullscreen helps with the small original labels.
cards.status: Verified playback — navigation and sound snippets
cards.notes: Unmodified projector movie. The embedded album announcement supplies the year 2004. Language selection, START, SOUND SNIPPETS, INFO, audio and player controls were checked. Historical universal-rock.de subscription/send-to-friend services are not recreated.

cards.title: Benzin Game
cards.description: Drive a fire truck through a field and score as much damage as possible in 90 seconds. The original French-language game is preserved.
cards.instructions: Click JOUER, then INSTRUCTIONS or JOUER. Arrow Up accelerates, Arrow Down brakes, and Left/Right steer. On mobile, hold Accelerate while using a Turn button. Scores work during the round; the old online scoreboard is not restored.
cards.status: Partial — driving and scoring work; video and online services are absent
cards.notes: Original SWF unchanged and byte-identical to the original in the independent Benzin project. Keyboard driving/scoring were verified with the wrapper metadata-focus fix; the on-screen controls also drive and score. Missing benzin1.flv, listpays.xml and historical score/form endpoints are not recreated. This site has no leaderboard backend. Archive label 2005 is not used as a verified year. See qa/BENZIN-VERIFICATION.md and patches/README.md.

cards.title: Keine Lust
cards.description: The Keine Lust promotional microsite, with animated artwork, information, competition, video and screensaver panels.
cards.instructions: Mouse: click the menu items (INTRO / INFO / WIN / VIDEO / TOUR / SCREENSAVER / BUY). The sign-up form's Flash components also accept keyboard input (text entry, Enter/Space, arrow-key list navigation). Video streams load from the historical exodus.interoutemediaservices.com host and audio tracks from relative audio/trackN.mp3 files; availability is not verified.
cards.status: Partial — menus work; external audio and video are absent
cards.notes: All seven menu items were verified with corrected click coordinates; the initial blocked verdict was a QA error. The music player's missing player_txt.txt is reconstructed from its embedded title with an inferred single-track count, separately documented under patches/keine-lust/. Original SWF unchanged. Audio files, external video streams and historical services are not restored. Archive label 2005 is not a verified year. See qa/KEINE-LUST-REPAIR.md.

cards.title: Mann gegen Mann
cards.description: The Mann gegen Mann single e-card, with striking artwork, album information and the original promotional links.
cards.instructions: Click the small deutsch or english label on the left. Use INFO and VIDEO to explore. The trailer link opens its original panel, but the external trailer file is missing.
cards.status: Partial — e-card works; external trailer is missing
cards.notes: Original SWF unchanged. Its embedded 'out 03.03.06' text corrects the archive's 2005 filename label. Language selection, INFO/VIDEO, intro audio and player controls were checked. Trailer requests for SteelExternalAll.swf and rammstein_22sec_clean.flv returned 404. Historical newsletter/send services are not recreated.

cards.title: Rosenrot
cards.description: A journey around Rosenrot's ship-in-ice artwork, with album panels, wind ambience and music.
cards.instructions: Click the small deutsch or english label to begin, then explore the ship and album panels. Fullscreen helps with the small language labels.
cards.status: Verified playback — ship, album views and audio
cards.notes: Unmodified movie extracted from the preserved projector. Language selection, ship/album/send views, audio, mute and player controls were checked. Historical email services and the in-card remote Benzin link are not restored; launch Benzin separately from this collection. Dates of 2005 live recordings in the text do not independently establish the card's release year.

cards.title: Rosenrot Single
cards.description: Animated Rosenrot single artwork and a preserved announcement for the original video premiere campaign.
cards.instructions: Watch the animated sequence through to the newsletter panel. The panel is historical: subscription and video-link delivery are not available here.
cards.status: Partial — animation and audio work; newsletter delivery is not restored
cards.notes: Original SWF unchanged. The embedded subscription deadline supplies the year 2005. Animation/audio and progression to the newsletter form were checked, along with restart and fullscreen. The historical mail servlet has not been recreated; no subscription was submitted during testing.

cards.title: Völkerball
cards.description: A gold-and-black Völkerball microsite with concert photographs, a gallery and an overview of the DVD editions.
cards.instructions: Let the intro finish, then explore INFO and the gallery thumbnails. PREVIEW, SEND and DOWNLOAD depend on original online services or files that are not included.
cards.status: Partial — gallery and audio work; previews and downloads are absent
cards.notes: Original SWF unchanged. The embedded copyright line supplies 2006. Gallery/menu views, website/shop prompts, audio, mute and player controls were checked. Password previews, wallpaper files and historical send/competition services are not restored.

cards.title: LIFAD
cards.description: A short Liebe ist für alle da promotional intro presenting the album artwork.
cards.instructions: Watch or click through the intro. ZUR WEBSITE opens the original link to the band website.
cards.status: Verified playback — animated artwork and website link
cards.notes: Original SWF unchanged. Intro progression, the ZUR WEBSITE prompt, restart and fullscreen were checked. No audio signal was observed in the exercised screens. The video stream is embedded in the movie; its decompiler-exported FLV is not a missing runtime companion. Archive label 2009 is not treated as a verified year.

cards.title: Pussy
cards.description: The pink-and-black Pussy single announcement, with animated artwork and the original video premiere notice.
cards.instructions: Let the animation reach its final announcement screen, then click MORE for the original Rammstein blog link.
cards.status: Verified playback — animation, audio and MORE link
cards.notes: Original SWF unchanged. The embedded premiere notice supplies the year 2009. Animation, audio, mute, restart, fullscreen and the MORE URL prompt were checked. External video/blog destinations are not archived by this project.
